name: Hu Luo

profile.page_description: Hu Luo, a Ph.D. candidate in Biomedical Engineering at Fudan University, working on vision-based tactile sensing, multidimensional force estimation, and gait biomechanics.

intro_paragraphs: I am a Ph.D. candidate in Biomedical Engineering at **Fudan University**, focusing on **vision-based tactile sensing and multidimensional force measurement** for gait analysis and robotics. I received my bachelor's degree from **Xi'an Jiaotong University** in 2021. Beyond academia, I founded **Medical and Engineering Innovators (医工学人)** in 2022, a nonprofit community promoting interdisciplinary knowledge sharing across medicine and engineering.

My doctoral research spans **vision-based tactile sensor development, deep-learning-based force decoupling, sensing-feature analysis, performance benchmarking, and scalable calibration through transfer learning and knowledge distillation**. I have further extended these advances to **wearable sensing systems and large-area force platforms** for dynamic gait analysis. Since 2024, I have collaborated with **ANTA Sports** on sports biomechanics and human movement assessment. Since 2025, I have helped establish **NeoteAI**, translating tactile sensing technologies into embodied robotics and leading the development and launch of multiple tactile sensing products for robotic hands.

My current research interests center on **tactile perception and embodied intelligence**, particularly integrating tactile sensing with learning-based robotic manipulation and control. I am especially interested in **healthcare robotics**, including robotic ultrasound, rehabilitation, and assistive manipulation, where tactile feedback can enable more intelligent, adaptive, and reliable physical interactions.

patents.title: A Flexible, High-Resolution, Optics-Based Multidimensional Force Tactile Sensor and Fabrication Method Thereof
patents.inventors: Luo Hu, Chen Wen-Ming, Jiang Xi-Lin, Huang Ran, Ma Xin
patents.summary: A flexible optical sensing interface combines a transparent silicone layer, embedded particles, illumination and an RGB camera. A neural network maps the observed deformation to force information, linking sensor construction with calibration for multidimensional tactile measurement.

patents.title: Multidimensional Force Decoupling Method and System, Storage Medium, and Computer Program Product
patents.summary: This invention concerns the decoupling of multidimensional forces through a computational method and system. It addresses the interpretation stage of tactile sensing: separating coupled force components so that contact can be represented in more than one direction.

patents.title: Distributed Force Estimation Method and System, Storage Medium, and Computer Program Product
patents.summary: This invention focuses on distributed force estimation. Its subject is the recovery of how force is spread over a contact region, complementing work on multidimensional force decoupling and spatially resolved tactile perception.

patents.title: A Visuotactile Sensor, Robotic Hand, and Tactile Perception and Manufacturing Methods Thereof
patents.summary: This invention brings together a visuotactile sensor, its manufacturing method and tactile perception for a robotic hand. It connects sensing hardware with the process of turning contact-induced visual information into robotic touch.

patents.title: Visuotactile Sensor, Robotic Hand, and Control Method Thereof
patents.summary: This invention concerns a visuotactile sensor and its use in a robotic hand, together with a related control method. It extends the sensing component into an integrated hand system where tactile information can support control.

patents.title: A Simulation Method and Apparatus for Visuotactile Sensors, Storage Medium, Program Product, and Computing Device
patents.summary: This invention concerns simulation methods and computing tools for visuotactile sensors. It forms part of my work on connecting the physical behavior of tactile hardware with computational representations used in sensing development.

patents.title: A Tactile Perception Method and Apparatus for Visuotactile Sensors, Storage Medium, Program Product, and Computing Device
patents.summary: This invention focuses on the tactile-perception stage of a visuotactile sensing system. It concerns methods and computing components for interpreting visual observations of contact as tactile information.

patents.title: A Data Acquisition Method, Apparatus, and System for Calibrating Visuotactile Sensors
patents.summary: This invention concerns data acquisition for calibrating visuotactile sensors. It focuses on the supporting method, apparatus and system needed to collect calibration information for learned tactile sensing.

patents.title: A Method, System, Computing Device, and Storage Medium for Inverse Estimation of Dynamic Pressure Distribution
patents.inventors: Luo Hu, Huang Qiu-Hui, Xiao Qing-Xia, Wang Shao-Bai
patents.summary: This invention addresses inverse estimation of dynamic pressure distributions. Its subject is reconstructing how pressure is distributed over time, connecting computational estimation with the measurement of changing contact loads.

patents.title: A Model Deployment Method, Apparatus, Device, and Medium for Visuotactile Sensors
patents.summary: This invention concerns the deployment of models for visuotactile sensors. It addresses the transition from a developed sensing model to its use in a working device, complementing my research on calibration and practical tactile inference.

patents.title: A Gait Analysis Method, Related Apparatus, and Computer Storage Medium
patents.inventors: Chen Wen-Ming, Luo Hu, Huang Qiu-Hui, Wang Fan-Jie, Ma Xin
patents.summary: This invention concerns a gait-analysis method and associated computing apparatus. It connects the interpretation of human movement with the sensing and analysis systems developed through my biomechanics research.
